title: lens config (.lens.json)
description: Merged over lens.defaults.json: scalars override, maps merge, lists extend. `lens config` shows the result and where each value comes from.

fold.description: The category's score (0-3: a region folds when it's at or below the fold level), or false: never folds.

texts.description: Extends the defaults' list. An entry "!x" takes "x" out of the defaults instead.

base.description: false: this file is the whole rule set, without lens.defaults.json.

foldLevel.description: Regions with a score at or below this fold; -1 folds nothing.

theme.description: The Shiki theme the viewer starts in.

folds.description: Per category: its score, or false to never fold it. A category not named scores 1.

callPatterns.description: Fire-and-forget calls to fold, under their category. Extends the defaults' list.

receivers.description: Receiver names; * matches within a name ("*Logger").

methods.description: Only these methods; any when left out.

keepDirective.description: A region containing it, or right below it, never folds.

buildPreviews.description: Summary mode asks for previews and sequences.

selfChecks.description: Summary mode asks for questions to check your understanding with.

scores.description: Replaced by folds: a score there.
